title: thelypteris glabra
intro: Thelypteris glabra, commonly known as the Smooth Ground Oak or Smooth Shield Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is prized for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris glabra include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which can aid in relieving muscle cramps and spasms. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
